Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1403
Claimant:
Courtney Webb
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
6-29-25
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision in a shopping center parking lot. The claimant, the
other vehicle's driver, has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
9-21-25
Reviewed the first notice of loss and confirmed the driver is named on the policy. Coverage appears to be in force for
the vehicle involved and the reported circumstances.
9-22-25
Obtained the initial photographs from the insured and the claimant's side. The visible damage is mostly in line with the
impact described by both parties.
10-3-25
Two witnesses who were in the lot have given statements. Both confirm the collision happened in the manner
described, with the vehicles backing into one another while maneuvering out of parking spaces.
10-14-25
Claimant's counsel submitted a demand package including initial treatment records reporting a back strain. The
reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type, though the records do not yet describe the claimant's seating
position at impact.
10-21-25
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated records and an itemized
list of visits to understand the course of care.
11-3-25
Medical history provided shows no prior injury to the same area of the back. No earlier claims involving this body
region have been identified in the index search.
12-5-25
Spoke with the claimant's counsel about the seating position. It is not fully clear from the current file where in the
vehicle the claimant was sitting, and the answer may matter for evaluating the injury mechanism.
1-9-26
Claimant later supplied a few additional details about the moments before impact. These are minor, and the core
account has stayed the same since the first statement.
2-12-26
Inspection noted a few old scratches on the claimant's vehicle that may predate this incident. A neighbor has also
mnetioned seeing earlier damage a few weeks before the claimed date, and this is being followed up before any
valuation is finalized.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
